root_cause: Repository Writer Candidate Shadow was triggered for every pull request and then skipped for non-writer branches. Four canonical writers also depended on that global trigger instead of explicitly dispatching immutable writer-candidate identity.
prevention: Every canonical writer must resolve exact PR/base/head/branch identity and explicitly dispatch repo-writer-candidate-shadow.yml. The shadow workflow is workflow_dispatch-only, so ordinary PRs allocate no shadow run.

evidence.observed_before: ordinary pull requests allocated Repository Writer Candidate Shadow and immediately skipped it
evidence.expected_after: ordinary pull requests do not create a Candidate Shadow run; all seven canonical writers dispatch exact PR/base/head/ref identity explicitly
evidence.verification_mode_authority: dispatch-only shadow binds verification_only directly from inputs.verification_only; event-name fallback is forbidden
